about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a young developer and cybersecurity enthusiast. My main focus is understanding how systems work under the hood: from low-level code and electronics to web applications.
about.p2: On a daily basis, I use Linux, tinker with microcontrollers, and build security labs. Right now, I am focusing on solving challenges on pwn.college and Hackclub.com projects. I love exploring systems deeply enough to understand how they break and how to secure them.
about.p3: In my free time, I train in the gym, play chess, and read about physics and engineering.
about.p3books: (Andrzej Dragan, Gang of Four, Harvard Business Review)
